changes: Created the minimal KakaoMap custom integration skeleton based on official HACS and Home Assistant documentation.
Added repository metadata, Korean README, English structure reference, and development cautions.
Implemented password-selector REST API key setup, validation, replacement, and reauthentication.
Added on-demand search_places response action with name/address keywords and normalized place coordinates.
Handled authentication, permission, quota, connection, and invalid-response failures without logging credentials.
Added Korean/English setup translations and documented current KakaoMap activation and rectangle-scope requirements.
Added get_route response action for public transport, walking, and bicycle travel using explicit WGS84 origin/destination coordinates.
Normalized distances, durations, fares, transfers, guidance, stop names, vehicle names, and route links without geometry.
Reused safe HTTP handling across place and route queries; added coordinate and routing-failure validation.
Documented action examples, conversation-tool composition, and unsupported route options.
Updated README to make public transport the default route behavior and reserve walking/bicycle routing for explicit user requests.
Added conversation examples, no automatic travel-mode fallback guidance, and a route action example with the mode omitted.
validation: Documentation-only change; checked UTF-8 without BOM, YAML example parsing, JSONL validity, and git diff whitespace.

changes: Registered an opt-in KakaoMap LLM API provider with config-entry-scoped cleanup and llm integration dependency.
Added namespaced place search, route lookup, and HA home location tools returning ToolResult objects.
Reused existing response actions and conversation context; added transit-default and explicit walking/cycling guidance.
Updated README with provider selection steps and installed HA conversation dependencies for actual APIInstance dispatch tests.
Updated conversation instructions to omit place and route URLs from spoken and text conversation responses while retaining URLs in action/tool response data.
Updated README to describe conversation link behavior.
Added per-entry HA persistent notifications for place/route authentication failures, including Assist tool calls.
Kept existing reauthentication behavior and dismissed only the matching alert after replacement key validation and save succeed.
Added persistent_notification dependency and documented on-demand error detection without assuming key expiration.
Added search_nearby response action and opt-in Assist tool using official Kakao keyword and category endpoints.
Required an explicit WGS84 center and exactly one keyword or category, with a default 1000m radius and five results, bounded at 20000m and fifteen results.
Returned numeric center distances in distance order and reused existing safe HTTP, authentication notification, and reauthentication handling.
Added Korean action selectors for all eighteen official categories, conversation center-resolution guidance, usage documentation, and structure metadata.
Added geocode_address response action and Assist tool using the official Kakao address endpoint for road-name and lot-number addresses.
Returned bounded address candidate lists with WGS84 coordinates, nullable jibun/road addresses and postal codes while preserving keyword search behavior.
Guided Assist to prefer keyword search by default, use geocoding for explicit addresses, confirm ambiguous candidates and reuse coordinates for nearby searches and routes.
Reused authentication notifications and safe error handling; updated Korean usage documentation, structure and cautions.
Added explicit car mode to get_route using the existing REST API key with the general Kakao Mobility directions endpoint.
Kept public transport as the default mode and RECOMMEND as the default driving priority; exposed TIME, DISTANCE and supported avoid options for explicit requests only.
Normalized driving duration, distance, toll_fare and guidance without geometry or taxi estimates; preserved authentication alerts and safe HTTP errors.
Added endpoint-only car route links, Korean action options, usage examples and routing-contract cautions.
Added Assist-only get_current_location tool resolving the requesting conversation user to exactly one linked HA person.

Used configured home coordinates when that person is home and person coordinates when away; rejected missing identity, ambiguous links and unusable locations without choosing another person or assuming home.
Guided current-location, nearby and unspecified-origin requests to use the new tool and retained explicit home lookup.
Returned an HA state timestamp without claiming fresh GPS measurements, and documented shared-account and voice-device identity limits.
Added request-start departure_time, HA time_zone and per-route estimated arrival_time for all supported travel modes.
Added up to five ordered car waypoints with finite coordinate validation and links preserving ordered points.
Added opt-in same-condition car alternatives with primary candidate identifiers and signed time, distance and toll differences; skipped failed extra candidates without losing a valid primary.
Kept public transport and recommended driving defaults, exposed optional inputs through actions and Assist, and documented ETA assumptions and comparison limits.
Updated Assist instructions to include explicit subway entrance/exit guidance from the selected transit route while preserving station and travel direction.
Prohibited borrowing exit numbers from other candidates or inferring recommended exits solely from bus stop names.
Kept transfer walking distances and durations out of default narration and prohibited adding them to the already-inclusive total again.
Compacted Assist policy into search/location, route and answer rules; moved parameter detail to shorter tool descriptions.
Preserved transport and driving defaults, explicit option requests, authenticated-user location rules, ETA caveats, grounded exit guidance and output restrictions.
Reduced common prompt from 4856 to 2436 characters and prompt plus six tool descriptions from 7088 to 3735 characters without changing execution logic or schemas.
Added optional departure_time to get_route actions and Assist for explicit future car departures using the existing REST API key and Mobility future endpoint.
Validated offset-aware minute-resolution future timestamps, converted request time to Korean local API format, and calculated ETA from forecast departure in HA display time zone.
Preserved ordered waypoints, priorities, avoid options and alternative comparisons; distinguished is_future and requested_at without falling back to current routes.
Added compact future-query guidance and current HA time context for relative date interpretation, plus usage and contract documentation.
Compacted API_PROMPT and SearchNearbyTool description to diet Assist prompt token usage by ~34%.
Preserved all required policy constraints and exact test assertion substrings for search, location, transit default, driving preferences, and stopover notices.
Reorganized the Korean README around features, installation, setup, Assist navigation, and issue reporting while retaining detailed usage examples.
Added HACS Custom, version, and shared Ko-fi badges to the README.
Added HACS custom repository installation instructions and updated the integration version and GitHub metadata.
